ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity (black) pixels with a ratio of approximately 95:5 against high-intensity (white) localized marks, excluding bottom-edge water cavitation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous low-intensity black region; secondary high-intensity features include small, isolated white speckles scattered sparsely across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 105 degrees; notch depth is roughly 1/6th of the total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular high-frequency serrations present along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of vertical variations ranges from 3 to 12 pixels; serrations are most jagged on the medial and lateral sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Moderate convex sweep on the trailing edge of both lobes; overall orientation is near-horizontal with minimal upward taper until the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct yellowish-white pixel clusters (likely barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme lateral tips of the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several visible thin, white linear streaks; one significant horizontal mark in the lower-left quadrant and multiple shorter, unaligned diagonal marks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-white encrustations or callosities at the distal tips; scattered white linear scars (rake marks) on the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive yellowish hue in the tip clusters contrasted against the standard white scar tissue pigmentation.
